publish.title: T-Rex vs Spinosaurus: 3D Storm Swamp Battle (4K AI Creature Feature)
publish.description: A cinematic 3D CGI clash between two apex prehistoric titans — Tyrannosaurus rex and Spinosaurus — in a flooded cypress swamp during a violent night thunderstorm. Built end-to-end with reference-locked character anatomy, Star-Anchored keyframes, Veo 3.1 3D water/ember physics, and 3-layer sound design at -14 LUFS.

panels.title: shot_01 START - Spino Sail Wake
panels.description: 1.5m water-level low-angle 3/4 shot past blurred foreground cypress roots; Spino's weathered 2-meter dorsal sail slices diagonally through black swamp water toward camera, burning log glow in background mist

panels.title: shot_01 END - Swamp Breach
panels.description: 1.5m low-angle 3/4 shot; Spino erupts upward out of the churning black water, crocodile jaws wide open in a guttural roar as sheets of water cascade off its chest under steel-teal rain

panels.title: shot_02 - Rex Stalks & Log Stomp
panels.description: 1.6m low-angle 3/4 medium close-up past foreground cypress trunk; Rex stalks forward through knee-deep mud, heavy wet foot crushing a burning fallen redwood log casting warm 2700K amber firelight on its underbelly

panels.title: shot_03 START - Predators Charge
panels.description: 1.4m low-angle 3D depth shot; Rex on the left and Spino on the right charge toward each other across the flooded cypress clearing with jaws wide open as orange embers swirl over the black water

panels.title: shot_03 END / shot_04 - Chest Clash
panels.description: 1.4m low-angle 3D depth clash; Rex on the left and Spino on the right slam chest-to-chest in center clearing, sending a massive geyser of muddy black water exploding into the rain

panels.title: shot_04 END / shot_04b - OTS Claw Grapple
panels.description: 1.6m Over-The-Shoulder 3D close-up behind Spino on the right; Spino clamps its long jaws over Rex's upper skull ridge on the left and raises its mud-caked hooked claws to slash Rex's snout

panels.title: shot_05 - Burning Cypress Slam
panels.description: 1.5m low-angle 3/4 impact shot; Spino on the right slashes Rex's snout and slams Rex's heavy flank into a burning cypress trunk on the left in a violent shower of glowing orange embers and bark splinters

panels.title: shot_06a/b/c - Neck Jaw Clamp
panels.description: 1.6m close-up 3/4 jaw-clamp shot; Rex on the left ducks Spino's claw and clamps its massive serrated jaws deep into the side of Spino's wet slate-olive neck on the right, wrinkling the thick hide

panels.title: shot_07/08 - Takedown & Victory Roar
panels.description: 1.4m low-angle finale; Spino lies thrashing defeated in the churning black water on the right while Rex towers dominant on the left with its foot planted on a burning log, roaring victoriously into the night rain
